theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (z e w : Euclid P) (L : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → ‖w‖ = 1 → w = inner ℝ w z • z + inner ℝ w e • e → ‖w - z‖ < L / 2 → ∃ (θ : ℝ) (v : Euclid P), 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < L ∧ (v = e ∨ v = -e) ∧ w = Real.cos θ • z + Real.sin θ • v
